instruction: The master slides panel is not visible. Please enable the master slides view.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=9, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: Task asks to enable the master slides view in LibreOffice Impress. Config modified to close master slides panel (down presses=9). Custom metric checks for Master Slides panel/view in accessibility tree. Similar difficulty to original task.
